notes.title: Launcher Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822214/4d6794895e5319ecb90d6c3cac4edcb04af9f305.png[/img][b]

[h2]Welcome to the new update! [/h2][/b]
We have added a special [b]FoxSox Games Launcher[/b] to our games. 
The launcher automatically starts only when you begin the game and closes immediately after the game starts. Its main purpose is to inform you about the latest updates in our game offerings. This is an optional feature, so you can choose to skip it and go directly to the game by selecting the appropriate option when launching the game.

Additionally, we've implemented a few minor improvements that enhance performance and fix some minor bugs in the game.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822214/58d402d0b54eb249ab715e105690e45a11dc7f2e.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Update 1.1[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the framerate on the last stage of the game.
[*] New sound effects have been added.
[*] Improved the volume of music and sound effects.
[*] Improved the interface.
[*] Added a counter measuring the strength of a jump.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[*] The game was tested on Steam Deck and adjusted to the system requirement.
[/list]
